verdict.rationale: Vue's official Provide / Inject guide documents a first-party dependency-injection mechanism: parent components act as dependency providers for any descendant, plus app-level provide (app.provide) and Symbol-keyed injection, so components can be organized as injected building blocks. Community comments praise single-file components as modular units but do not address provide/inject. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of provide/inject in real apps, evidence of DI scoping beyond the component tree and app level (e.g. module-scoped injectors or lifecycle-managed services).

support.subject: As a developer, I can organize my app into modular, dependency-injected building blocks

citations.quote: A parent component can serve as a dependency provider for all its descendants. Any component in the descendant tree, regardless of how deep it is, can inject dependencies provided by components up in its parent chain.
The page also covers app-level provide (app.provide) for application-wide dependencies and injection with Symbol keys.
